equipment.description: Fractionating column for separation of liquid mixtures based on boiling point differences.
Packed or trayed column for removing specific gas components using a liquid solvent.
Column used to remove dissolved gases from a liquid using a stripping gas or steam.
Agitated reactor for continuous liquid-phase chemical reactions.
Tubular reactor for continuous gas or liquid reactions with minimal back-mixing.
Jacketed vessel for carrying out chemical reactions in discrete batches.
Standard API 610 overhung pump for general process fluids.
Rotary gear pump for handling highly viscous chemical products.
Air-operated double-diaphragm pump for safe transfer of corrosive chemicals.
Multi-stage centrifugal compressor for process gas handling.
High-pressure piston compressor for specific gas compression needs.
TEMA type AES heat exchanger for process liquid heating or cooling.
Gasketed plate heat exchanger for efficient low-pressure heat transfer.
Fin-fan cooler for process fluid cooling using ambient air.
Kettle-type reboiler for generating vapor at the bottom of a distillation column.
Overhead shell and tube condenser for column vapor streams.
API 650 atmospheric floating-roof tank for chemical storage.
ASME Section VIII pressure vessel for intermediate process storage.
Vessel for rapid vapor-liquid separation following a pressure reduction.
Horizontal vessel for gravity-based separation of immiscible liquid phases.
In-line bag filter for removing solid particles from process liquid streams.
Multi-cartridge filter housing for fine filtration of chemical products.
Decanter centrifuge for continuous separation of solids from a liquid slurry.
Direct-heated rotary dryer for reducing moisture content in solid chemicals.
Forced-circulation crystallizer for producing solid crystals from a saturated solution.
API 600 cast steel gate valve for robust on/off isolation.
Manual globe valve for precise throttling of process fluids.
Quarter-turn trunnion-mounted ball valve for quick and tight shut-off.
Swing check valve to prevent backflow in process piping.
Pneumatic globe-style control valve for modulating flow, pressure, or temperature.
Spring-loaded safety relief valve to protect equipment from overpressure.
Non-reclosing pressure relief device for primary or secondary overpressure protection.
Direct mass flow measurement instrument for critical chemical transfers.
In-line electromagnetic flow meter for corrosive or conductive fluids.
Vortex shedding meter for steam and gas flow measurement.
Non-contact radar transmitter for continuous level monitoring in storage tanks.
DP transmitter configured for level measurement in pressurized vessels.
Smart pressure transmitter for continuous monitoring of process pressure.
Platinum resistance temperature detector in a standard thermowell.
Type K thermocouple for high-temperature reactor monitoring.
On-line process gas chromatograph for continuous composition analysis.
In-line pH measurement system for process control and neutralization.
Paramagnetic oxygen analyzer for monitoring inert gas blanketing systems.
TEFC squirrel-cage induction motor for driving pumps and compressors.
VFD unit for energy-efficient speed control of large electric motors.
Metal-clad switchgear assembly for medium voltage power distribution.
Centralized LV MCC for process motor starting and protection.
Industrial UPS system for critical plant control and emergency shutdown systems.
Oil-filled step-down transformer for plant electrical network.
Elevated flare system for safe combustion of waste or emergency relief gases.
Induced draft cooling tower for process plant heat rejection.
Rotary screw air compressor package providing dry, oil-free instrument air.
